definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese festival game where players try to scoop goldfish from a shallow pool using a thin paper scoop called a poi. A staple attraction at summer festivals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏祭|なつまつ}り→夏祭り：09871_natsumatsuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{金魚|きんぎょ}すくい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I played goldfish scooping at the summer festival.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{金魚|きんぎょ}すくい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{夢中|むちゅう}→夢中：03752_muchuu⟧になっていた。
examples.english: The children were absorbed in goldfish scooping.

examples.japanese: {金魚|きんぎょ}すくい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{三匹|さんびき}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{取|と}れた→取れる：02376_toreru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一匹|いっぴき}→一匹：08930_ippiki⟧しかいなかった。
examples.english: I scooped three goldfish, but by the next day only one was left.

notes:
A beloved summer festival (⟦{夏祭|なつまつ}り→夏祭り：09871_natsumatsuri⟧ / ⟦{縁日|えんにち}→縁日：10620_ennichi⟧) activity. Players pay a small fee and use a ポイ — a thin paper stretched over a wire frame — to try to scoop up ⟦{金魚|きんぎょ}→金魚：00233_kingyo⟧ from a shallow tub of water. The challenge is that the paper tears easily when wet.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金魚|きんぎょ}すくい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to play goldfish scooping)
- {金魚|きんぎょ}すくい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧ (goldfish scooping stall)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Goldfish scooped at festivals often don't survive long at home, which is a common shared experience in Japan. Professional {金魚|きんぎょ}すくい competitions also exist.
